##### Project general facts

Coco Hills is a skyline lifestyle residence by Coco Development Group, a seasoned developer with nearly a decade of experience creating lifestyle-driven assets across Bali. This stunning development offers a collection of beautifully designed properties in one of the island's most exclusive locations. Surrounded by luxury villas and breathtaking ocean and city views, Coco Hills is more than just a home, it is a destination for those seeking the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and elegance, backed by a flexible payment structure and strong investment potential.

Residents enjoy top-class amenities designed to support a complete and vibrant lifestyle. The development features a fully equipped gym, a podcast studio, a modern co-working space, wellness treatments, and a relaxing pool with a beach-inspired vibe. An on-site restaurant adds to the convenience, while the welcoming community atmosphere makes every day feel connected and enriching. Every element is crafted to ensure that residents can work, play, and recharge without ever leaving the premises.

Every property at Coco Hills embodies the perfect harmony between contemporary architecture and the breathtaking natural beauty of Uluwatu’s cliffs and expansive sea views. The use of locally sourced wood ensures that each residence harmonizes with its surroundings, offering a warm and inviting atmosphere. Cutting-edge design meets eco-friendly construction techniques, creating sustainable and modern living spaces. From private pools and fully equipped kitchens to spacious living areas, each home is a sanctuary of comfort and elegance, ready to be enjoyed from the moment of arrival.

##### Parking 
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the beautiful hills of Bingin within Badung regency, this exceptional location places residents in Bali’s most sought-after area, renowned for offering the highest rental prices and the island’s three most Instagrammed beaches. Bingin is a place where dramatic cliffs meet turquoise waters, creating a landscape of rare beauty and tranquility. The area is surrounded by luxury villas and offers breathtaking panoramic views of both the ocean and the city skyline.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional lifestyle offerings and vibrant community. World-famous beach clubs, acclaimed restaurants, wellness spas, and boutique shopping are all within easy reach, making it a magnet for discerning travelers from around the globe. The neighborhood perfectly balances seclusion with accessibility, offering a peaceful retreat that remains connected to Bali’s cultural and social heart.

For those seeking a residence that embodies both prestige and natural beauty, Bingin delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of stunning coastlines, luxury amenities, and strong investment fundamentals has made it one of Bali’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where contemporary elegance meets island serenity, an ideal setting for those who demand the very best.
